title: Lifecycle changes in ggplot2
description:
Hi Jenny,

In ggplot2 we're disallowing the `show_guide` argument, which has been deprecated since ggplot2 2.0.0.
This PR updates the examples to use the modern equivalent.
We plan to release mid June and it would be nice if we didn't break gapminder :)

Best wishes,
Teun

title: Addition of ISO Country Codes (Char and Num) to gapminder data objects
description:
## Description

This commits changes the following:
- Adds [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) and [ISO 3166-1 numeric](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_numeric) country codes as two additional variables for the `gapminder` and `gapminder_unfiltered` objects
- Updates documentation (mostly) to reflect added variables
## Motivation and Context
- Addresses https://github.com/jennybc/gapminder/issues/13
## How Has This Been Tested?
- Local tests have not been run yet.
## Types of changes
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
## Checklist:
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [x] My change requires a change to the documentation.
- [x] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass
